text:
Rae (People Ops): Heads-up: Diego (international new hire) is arriving from abroad but wants to start remotely Mon. He only has an embassy-issued notary and a foreign passport. Need an I-9 plan + laptop delivery + benefits enrollment guidance.
Diego (new hire): Hi all — I can get an embassy notarized copy of my passport and a bank statement with my current address. My visa stamp is valid for entry but I'm not stateside yet. Can we do a virtual I-9 with embassy notary?
Marta (Hiring Ops): Embassy notaries are acceptable for some checks but USCIS Section 2 still expects an in-person review by employer or authorized agent. We have two paths: 1) delay until you return for physical I-9, or 2) use an authorized representative in the US + rep waiver. Which is feasible for you?
Diego (new hire): I can arrange an authorized rep (my cousin in SF). He can come by our office or sign the rep waiver. Prefer not to delay start.
Liam (Security): Security note: authorized rep requires rep ID photo, rep-signed attestation, and employer-signed waiver. We also require a photocopy of the rep's ID and a timestamped photo of the rep holding the ID if we cannot meet them in person.
Diego (new hire): My cousin agreed. I'll DM his name & phone. Also question: benefits enrollment — can I start provisional enrollment before SSN is issued?
Payroll: You can complete benefits forms within 30 days; provisional enrollment can be recorded but payroll needs SSN for tax setup. Mark "SSN pending" on W-4 and remind payroll once you have it.
Marta (Hiring Ops): IT: Diego requested home delivery of a laptop to a US friend for pickup. Can we ship to 123 Mission St SF (friend address) and hold for pick-up?
IT (Shipping): We can ship to a hold-for-pickup address. Shipping command we used: ```create_label --to "Diego Alvarez (hold)" --addr "123 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105" --carrier FedEx --hold_for_pickup``` We'll image with standard profile and disable admin until clearance.
BadgeBot: Pickup pass created for diego.alvarez@redwood.com; expires 72 hours after arrival; QR emailed.
BackgroundsBot: Background intake shows passport country mismatch due to diacritics; manual review queued. Diego, please upload a high-res passport scan and any supporting name-change docs.
Diego (new hire): Uploaded passport scan + embassy notary. Also uploaded bank statement & enrollment forms.
Rae (People Ops): Quick timeline: if authorized rep packet + rep ID uploaded today, we can set I-9 status to "pending verification" and grant limited access (internal dev sandbox only). Full VPN and admin only after final clearance.
IT (Shipping): Shipping label created; ETA to SF hub tomorrow. We'll hold activation of VPN groups until you toggle "i9_verified" on the tracker.
Marta (Hiring Ops): Diego — Day-1 (remote): 8:30am PT onboarding call, 9:15 benefits walkthrough, 10:00 IT onboarding + laptop check-in. We'll send calendar invites once laptop arrival is confirmed.
Diego (new hire): Thanks everyone — cousin details DM'd. Appreciate the rapid help.
Rae (People Ops): Action items: 1) Diego to confirm rep attestation + rep ID photo (DONE pending), 2) IT to image & ship laptop (queued), 3) Backgrounds manual review (in progress), 4) Payroll provisional enroll flagged. I'll update tracker when background and I-9 are cleared.
Marta (Hiring Ops): Closing loop: if embassy notary was the only option, we'd have delayed. Great that authorized rep worked out. :party_popper:
